title: XDS GT600 retailer build specification post

capture.scope: Validated local 10-post detail archive; raw archive and media are not committed.

notes: The exact GT600 build is 11.5 kg with a carbon frame, fork and seatpost, SRAM Apex 1×11 with an 11–42T cassette, Apex HRD hydraulic brakes, thru-axles and fitted 700×40C tires. The fitted tire is not treated as manufacturer maximum clearance.
